reply.thought: I need to get the list of orders to calculate each customer's net balance (order amounts minus refunds).
I have the orders and the refunds. I need the net balance for each customer, which I can obtain with net_balance. I'll call net_balance for each distinct customer.

I have all net balances. Now I will record a payout for each customer with the net amount.
